vision.name: Namekian Enlightened Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your Styled attacks deal +1 stage of damage. At the start of your Rejuvenation Step, you may shuffle a Dragon Ball you control back into its owner's Life Deck.
POWER: Draw a card. Discard a card from your hand. If you discarded a Dragon Ball, raise your anger 2 levels and stops a physical or energy attack in your opponent's next action this combat.
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; number reads DR14; 'and stops' as printed
